# GRIP - Groupe de recherche et d'information sur la paix et la sécurité

GRIP - Groupe de recherche et d'information sur la paix et la sécurité is a nonprofit organization. The GRIP is an independent research center in the field of peace, security, and conflict prevention. Its researchers work on armed forces, defense, peace, governance, and security in Africa, as well as on the environmental impact of conflicts. GRIP - Groupe de recherche et d'information sur la paix et la sécurité employs 73 people (+2.8% YoY, +2 people) and has an annual revenue of $5.1M, founded in 1979. Headquartered in Brussels, Brussels Region, Belgium, with presence in Canada. Its workforce is distributed across 6 countries (including Belgium, France, Cameroon, Brazil, and India).

## About

GRIP is an independent research centre, based in Brussels (Belgium).
GRIP’s research work focuses mainly on the following domains:
 * Conflict prevention, management and resolution
 * Proliferation of small arms and control of the arms trade
 * European Union and international security
 * Defence economy.

More on details on the website: www.grip.org/en

Le GRIP est un centre de recherche indépendant, basé à Bruxelles (Belgique).		

Les travaux de recherche du GRIP s’articulent autour des axes suivants : 
 * Prévention, gestion et résolution des conflits violents
 * Prolifération des armes légères et contrôle des transferts d’armes
 * Union européenne et sécurité internationale
 * Economie de l’armement.

Plus de détails sur le site web : www.grip.org/fr

# Grip

Grip is a Software Development company. Grip is an AI-powered event platform for networking, matchmaking, and lead generation. It is trusted by SXSW, Money20/20, and Clarion Events to connect thousands of participants. Grip employs 90 people (+1.1% YoY, +1 person), founded in 2016. Headquartered in London, England, United Kingdom. Its workforce is distributed across 6 countries (including United Kingdom, Serbia, United States, Denmark, and Mexico).

## About

Grip is the AI-powered event platform built for engagement. It helps event organizers like SXSW, RX and Clarion Events establish, maintain and track relationships between participants over multiple events. This is possible because Grip goes beyond networking. It combines AI with billions of interactions happening across the platform and an intuitive mobile event app so participants meet the right people at the right time. This results in organizers benefitting from better event satisfaction scores, increased growth and ultimately, higher revenues.

properties.description: Grip is the AI-powered event platform built for engagement. It helps event organizers like SXSW, RX and Clarion Events establish, maintain and track relationships between participants over multiple events. This is possible because Grip goes beyond networking. It combines AI with billions of interactions happening across the platform and an intuitive mobile event app so participants meet the right people at the right time. This results in organizers benefitting from better event satisfaction scores, increased growth and ultimately, higher revenues.
